listing.title: Just One More Plant Shirt, Watercolor Houseplant Tee, Plant Lover Gift, Monstera Snake Plant Pothos Shirt, Gardening Gift, Plant Shirt
listing.description: Three potted houseplants painted in watercolor: a split-leaf monstera in a terracotta pot, a banded snake plant in a speckled cream pot and golden pothos trailing over a sage-green pot, under "just one more plant" in green script. The monstera has pale holes and slits, the pothos leaves carry cream streaks, and gold sparkles and two small pink hearts sit around them. A gift for anyone whose windowsill is always full, at Christmas or any time.

listing.trademark_check: Legal Desk screen 2026-11-19 (before any art): web searches '"PLANT LADY" trademark clothing class 25 registered', '"JUST ONE MORE PLANT" trademark USPTO', '"PLANT MOM" trademark registered clothing mugs USPTO' and '"ONE MORE PLANT" trademark class 25 OR class 21'. Found PLANT MOM registered for clothing (Reg. 6540815, live), so 'plant mom' is kept out of the art, title and tags; THE MODERN PLANT LADY (TMPL LLC) has filings including class 25 and PLANT LADY is registered in class 35 (Reg. 6753566), so 'plant lady' is kept out too. No record for JUST ONE MORE PLANT or ONE MORE PLANT; the nearest marks are different words (JUST1MORE, serial 98057922, a pending class 25 application; ONE PLANT, Reg. 5753266, class 25). The phrase is in wide use on other sellers' plant shirts. Aggregator pages (Justia, Markinton), not TSDR; tmsearch.uspto.gov is blocked from our sessions, so the owner can confirm in USPTO Trademark Search before listing. No plant-shop, nursery or brand name in the art, title or tags.
